hook: Wallace serves as President and CEO of Huston-Tillotson University in Austin, Texas, a historically Black university.
name: Melva Wallace

quote.text: President and CEO at Huston-Tillotson University - Austin, Texas

reading.body:
Melva Wallace leads Huston-Tillotson University, a historically Black institution in Austin, Texas, positioning her to shape AI access and literacy in higher education.

Austin's emergence as a major AI hub depends on workforce development and institutional capacity. Historically Black universities train a disproportionate share of Black engineers and computer scientists, yet face resource constraints that limit their ability to build AI labs, acquire computing hardware, or compete for faculty expertise. Wallace's role at an HBCU in a city with significant AI infrastructure and investment creates a point of leverage for addressing that gap.

This data covers Wallace's current position and location only. It does not describe her specific work on AI, her institution's computing resources, power access, or her public statements on the subject. It identifies her as an advocate and public voice in the ecosystem without clarifying what advocacy looks like in practice or what institutional barriers Huston-Tillotson faces in scaling AI capability relative to better-funded peers.
